name: Elisheva Kaufman
source:
Raised in a strict family where affection was rarely shown and personal achievements mattered more than emotions, Astra struggled with the discovery of her attraction to women during adolescence.

Knowing she couldn't rely on her family's support, she chose to isolate herself, systematically avoiding emotional connections or relationships of any kind.
That was the case—until she met Vesper, the first and only person with whom she managed to build a real bond.
From that relationship, Aegis was born.
